app_flow_learned: Impostor and 'بدون لا أشوف' are question cards inside the team board game (B01): the host screen shows a QR card, players scan it and continue on a phone in the browser.

Impostor on phone: choose team-1 player count -> enter names for both teams -> pass the phone hand to hand ('التلفون لازم يكون ب ايد N') -> each sees the secret thing, except the impostor -> who-asks-whom -> free questions counter -> vote -> drumroll -> reveal -> impostor guesses the thing -> result/winner.
'بدون لا أشوف' on host: two QR codes (one per team); answer view shows both players' things side by side.
